summary: Iteration 30 - Rental & tenancy tracker + Before/after compare slider + empty-state CTAs. Backend pytest 19/19 PASSED (test_iteration30.py). Frontend verified on 390x844 mobile viewport. BACKEND /api/rentals: (1) tenancy validators enforced -> empty name 422, rent<=0 422, bad start_date 422, end_date<start 400 'End date must be after the start date', rent_day>28 422. (2) POST tenancy returns {id}; GET /api/rentals?year=YYYY returns the exact shape: {year, tenancies[{id, tenant_name, rent, deposit, status(active/upcoming/ended), schedule[{month,due_on,due,paid,paid_on,status}], arrears, late_count}], expenses[], summary{rent_due, received, arrears, expenses, net, by_category, monthly[12], active_rent}} - monthly list is always 12 entries. due_on uses rent_day. (3) PUT /rentals/tenancies/{id}/rent/{YYYY-MM}: upserts a rent_payment and status computes correctly (paid when paid_amount >= rent; partial when 0<paid<rent; late when due_on<today and paid=0; due otherwise). paid_amount=0 deletes the row (clear). Invalid month '2026-13' -> 400 'Month must be YYYY-MM'. Cross-user tenancy -> 404. (4) Expenses: invalid category 422, amount<=0 422, bad date 422 'YYYY-MM-DD'. CRUD works and by_category + monthly expense totals update correctly. PUT on unknown id -> 404. (5) Scoping: creating tenancy on project A, switching active project (POST /api/projects/{id}/activate), GET /api/rentals returns 0 of it on project B - no cross-project leakage. (6) DELETE /rentals/tenancies/{id} cascade-deletes rent_payments (verified via Mongo count: 1 -> 0). FRONTEND flows all green when logged in via /auth?mode=login (demo@mybuilder.app/demo1234): Home dashboard shows rentals-card (navigates to /rentals) and the new sticky add-expense-button is present and tappable. /rentals screen: rentals-screen, rentals-year (shows 2026, prev goes to 2025, next back to 2026), rentals-prev-year, rentals-next-year, rentals-summary, rentals-net, rentals-received, rentals-expenses, rentals-arrears, add-tenancy-button, add-rental-expense-button all FOUND. New tenancy flow via tenancy-form (tenancy-name-input, tenancy-rent-input, tenancy-start-input, tenancy-save-button) added TEST_UI_* tenancy and 12 rent-month-{tid}-{YYYY-MM} cells rendered. rent-log-sheet opens from a month cell with rent-amount-input + rent-save-button; after paying 900, re-opening shows rent-clear-button. Expense form: all 7 chips present (rental-expense-cat-repairs/letting_agent/insurance/mortgage/service_charge/utilities/other), amount+date inputs, save button; after saving a 75 letting_agent expense the summary updated correctly to net=£825, expenses=£75, received=£900 (math checks out). tenancy-edit-{id} opens the form in edit mode and tenancy-delete-button + rental-expense-delete-button both work and remove the item. /compare screen (via media-compare-button on Media tab): compare-screen, before-after-slider, before-after-slider-handle all FOUND; 1 before thumbnail + 5 after thumbnails rendered with compare-before-{id} / compare-after-{id} testIDs; mouse-drag on the handle moves the clip divider (verified by two screenshots). compare-empty correctly not shown when photos exist. Timeline stage-compare-button code verified at stage-photos.tsx:34 (appears only when milestone has before+after - not exercised live because demo milestones don't have both phases). Budget/Team empty-state CTAs: wiring is correct in ui.tsx:177 (EmptyState auto-generates ${testID}-action for action+onAction) and both /(tabs)/budget.tsx:156 and /(tabs)/team.tsx:174 pass action+onAction. The empty state is NOT reachable on the demo seeded project because it already has line items + contacts. All seed data created in tests (TEST_iter30_* tenancies/expenses, TEST_UI_* UI tenancy, test secondary project) cleaned up via API. No React Native red screen. No deprecated expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch used in the files under review. All interactive elements have testID and touch targets are >= 44x44 (verified via iconBtn & Button styles).
action_items: No blocking issues. OPTIONAL: Budget/Team empty-state CTAs (budget-empty-action, team-empty-action) are coded correctly but cannot be exercised on the demo project which has seeded line items and contacts. If main agent wants an end-to-end UI assertion, consider either (a) a toggle to hide seed data or (b) a second project the test can switch to that is intentionally empty.

OPTIONAL: Timeline stage-compare-button is only shown when a milestone has BOTH a before photo and an after photo. Seeded milestones in the demo appear not to have that pairing on the active 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb' project, so the button wasn't exercised live. The code at /app/frontend/src/components/stage-photos.tsx:34 is correct; add a seed with both phases if you want an automated UI check.
COSMETIC: expo web preview emits 'shadow* style props deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' warning in RN web. Not a functional issue; comes from third-party styles. Can be ignored until RN upgrade.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rentals.py:65-73 _months() correctly computes the YYYY-MM range covered by a tenancy within a given year, including proper handling of month-end rollover (last = date(year + (m==12), m%12 + 1, 1)).
routes/rentals.py:104 status precedence 'paid if paid>=rent else partial if paid>0 else late if due_on<today else due' is correct and matches the review spec.
routes/rentals.py:108 arrears sum uses r['status'] in ('late','partial') AND due_on <= today -> prevents charging future months as arrears when the server date hasn't reached due_on yet.
routes/rentals.py:154-158 delete_tenancy correctly also wipes rent_payments scoped to {tenancy_id, user_id} - no orphan payment rows.
routes/rentals.py:170-172 paid_amount == 0 branch performs delete_one (not upsert of 0) which keeps the collection clean.
routes/rentals.py:93 expense `date` filter uses regex ^{year}- which is correct, however it depends on date being an ISO yyyy-mm-dd string (enforced by _iso validator at line 17).
routes/rentals.py excludes mongo _id in every output via the `{k:v for k,v in ... if k not in ('_id','user_id')}` pattern.

frontend/src/components/before-after-slider.tsx:28 PanResponder.onPanResponderMove uses posRef+start pattern to avoid stale closures; onStartShouldSetPanResponder returns true so handle responds to taps too.
frontend/src/components/ui.tsx:177 EmptyState auto-wires `${testID}-action` for the action button - matches the spec testIDs budget-empty-action & team-empty-action.
frontend/app/tenancy-form.tsx:51 end_date date-regex is only validated when non-empty - correct for the optional rolling tenancy case.

frontend/app/rentals.tsx:82 sticky CTA uses `position:'absolute'` with insets.bottom offset; works on web preview but ensure safe-area on devices with home indicator - fine with insets.bottom + space.lg.
frontend/app/rental-expense-form.tsx uses existing.description without null-coalesce (line 25) - works because the server defaults description='' but worth noting if the shape ever changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all in-scope testIDs reachable; math on summary verified (net=received-expenses)

Verified demo ends with original tenancy count / expense count unchanged on project 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb'. No Stripe/live calls made.
